resources.string: This shows every device signed in to your PodHopper account. Tap on the Profile page and log in first.
These are the devices signed in to your PodHopper account. If you no longer have one of them, sign it out here.
Could not load your devices. Check your connection and try again.
Sign out of all other devices
Sign this device out of your PodHopper account? A car or watch clears the podcasts stored on it. A phone or tablet does too when it is signed out from here.
Sign every other device out of your PodHopper account? Each one clears the podcasts stored on it and has to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
That device has been signed out.
Your other devices have been signed out.
Could not sign out. Check your connection and try again.

A signed-out device can keep working for up to an hour, and clears the podcasts stored on it the next time PodHopper runs on it with a connection. Devices running an older version of PodHopper show as Unknown device.
